script.purpose: Short warm asides and bylines only.

motion.name: firefly-flicker
motion.purpose: Decorative fireflies on teal night sections; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Teal Button
components.description: Primary action on cream pages (downloads, in-site CTAs).
components.css: .ds-btn-teal { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5em; font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; padding: 0.85em 1.7em; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; border: 2px solid transparent; background: var(--color-teal, #144c53); color: var(--color-white, #fff); transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-teal:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-teal-deep, #0c3339); } .ds-btn-teal:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-teal, #144c53); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Amber Button
components.css: .ds-btn-amber { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; padding: 0.85em 1.7em; border-radius: 999px; text-decoration: none; background: var(--color-amber, #f2a93b); color: var(--color-teal-deep, #0c3339); transition: transform 0.15s ease, background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-amber:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--color-amber-deep, #d3860f); box-shadow: 0 0 32px 4px rgba(242, 169, 59, 0.55); } .ds-btn-amber:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-teal, #144c53); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Activity Card
components.description: Downloadable activity tile with dashed coral top accent.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-cream-soft, #fffdf9); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -6px rgba(20, 76, 83, 0.18); padding: 1.75rem; border-top: 3px dashed var(--color-coral, #ef6f63); text-align: center; } .ds-card h3 { font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); color: var(--color-teal, #144c53); margin: 0 0 0.9rem; font-size: 1.05rem; }

components.name: Resource Card
components.description: External resource link card; same dashed top language as activities.
components.html:
Reading Rockets

Visit site →
components.css: .ds-resource { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; background: var(--color-cream-soft, #fffdf9); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px -6px rgba(20, 76, 83, 0.18); padding: 1.75rem; border-top: 3px dashed var(--color-coral, #ef6f63); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-resource:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -12px rgba(20, 76, 83, 0.25); } .ds-resource h2 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); font-size: 1.2rem; color: var(--color-teal, #144c53); } .ds-resource-label { font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-coral-ink, #b8453c); } .ds-resource:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-teal, #144c53); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Teal Night Section
components.description: Night band with optional firefly field.
components.css: .ds-night { background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--color-teal, #144c53) 0%, var(--color-teal-deep, #0c3339) 100%); color: var(--color-cream-soft, #fffdf9); padding: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem) 1.5rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-night-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 1160px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; } .ds-night h2 { font-family: var(--font-display, Fredoka, sans-serif); color: var(--color-white, #fff); margin: 0 0 0.6em; }

narrative.overview: The site feels like carrying a jar of fireflies through a New York night — deep teal night bands, cream daylight pages, and soft amber points that echo Rusty and Squeaks’ glowing jar. Book artwork leads; UI stays supportive and rounded for kids without talking down to the adults who buy, download, and teach.
keyCharacteristics: Book cover and character art as authority
Teal night sections with decorative fireflies
Cream pages with dashed coral card accents
Pill buttons and soft teal-tinted shadows

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Paint Rule
rules.body: Amber is light in the dark — fireflies, focus on teal, warm CTAs — not a blanket brand wash.

rules.name: The Bright-Is-Decoration Rule
rules.body: Raw coral and slate are for accents; text uses coral-ink / slate-ink / ink / teal.

dos: Do lead with real book and character art
Do keep free activities and resources easy to find
Do use fireflies only on teal night bands
Do name download controls with the activity title for assistive tech
donts: Don't invent brand art, testimonials, or series titles
Don't use thick colored left borders on cards
Don't put bright coral/slate on body copy
Don't globally nuke transitions under prefers-reduced-motion
Don't build a dark theme unless product asks for it
